title: Community Information Session: License Plate Reader Technology and Cameras
notes: Norwood Police Department community information session for Norwood residents about Flock Safety cameras and license plate reader (LPR) technology. Chief Christopher Padden and the department plan to explain what the technology is and is not, why NPD uses it, examples of its use in investigations and public safety, what information is collected, data-retention practices, system access and auditing, restrictions on sharing/use of Norwood data, and department safeguards. An open resident Q&A will follow. The meeting is intended to address public questions about privacy, data retention, information sharing, accountability, and law-enforcement use of LPR systems.
